notes.AIA-RISK-01: LLM support chatbot for orders/tariffs (server/src/llm.ts); no Art. 5 practice.
notes.AIA-RISK-02: README 'AI Act position': chatbot, no Annex III area, limited-risk with Art. 50 obligations.
notes.AIA-TRA-02: web/src/components/ChatWidget.tsx header: 'You are chatting with an AI assistant' shown from the first message.
notes.AIA-TRA-03: Replies are returned and rendered without any AI-generated marker or label; only a TODO(SUP-88) in server/src/llm.ts.
notes.GDPR-LAW-01: docs/privacy.md: Art. 6(1)(b) for support, 6(1)(f) for QA/complaints.
notes.GDPR-TRN-01: docs/privacy.md covers controller/DPO, purposes, legal basis, processor, retention, rights; linked from the widget.
notes.GDPR-RET-01: Retention defined and enforced (config/app.yaml transcript_days: 730, startRetentionJob in transcripts.ts) but 2 years of raw chat transcripts is not justified as necessary for support.
notes.GDPR-ERA-01: DELETE /admin/customers/:customerId/data -> deleteCustomerData removes messages and sessions (server/src/index.ts, transcripts.ts).
notes.GDPR-PBD-01: Full customer messages (may include e-mail/phone/address) are stored and sent unredacted to the third-party LLM; ADR 0001 says redaction was postponed.
notes.GDPR-SEC-01: RDS storage_encrypted with KMS and force-SSL parameter group (infra/terraform/db.tf); pg ssl; TLS ingress (infra/k8s/ingress.yaml).
notes.GDPR-SEC-02: Transcript export and erasure behind requireAdmin (SSO JWT with support-admin role, server/src/auth.ts).
notes.GDPR-ROPA-01: docs/ropa.md record PA-CC-07 with all Art. 30(1) items.
notes.ACME-01: ChatWidget.tsx disclosure banner before first interaction.
notes.ACME-02: No visible or machine-readable AI-generated label on replies; TODO only.
notes.ACME-03: logLlmCall logs timestamp, session id and model_version but not an input reference or the output, and log retention is 90 days (< 180).
notes.ACME-04: Raw chat transcripts kept 730 days (> 30) without a legal retention obligation.
notes.ACME-05: KMS-encrypted RDS, SSL to DB, TLS ingress with ssl-redirect.
notes.ACME-06: /api/chat declared in public_endpoints and rate-limited; admin routes require support-admin role.
notes.ACME-08: MODEL_CARD.md documents provider/model, owner, intended and out-of-scope use, product evaluation and limitations.
